claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: HTMT is a cationic amphiphilic histamine H1/H4 agonist that at 2.5 uM most plausibly causes weak, non-selective lysosomal/physicochemical stress rather than receptor-driven killing, since HRH1/HRH4 signaling is not cytotoxic in most cancer lines.
